footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to nCino: includes a $3.0M income tax benefit; after $4.5M attributable to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Jan 31, 2026 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 10.0% to $595M in fiscal 2026 (ended Jan 31, 2026). Gross margin was 60.6%, versus 60.1% a year earlier, and operating income was $3.7M, up from a $18.1M loss.
Net income was $5.2M, or $0.05 per share, after a $37.9M loss a year earlier. Operating cash flow was $90.1M and free cash flow $82.6M, versus $53.4M; nCino returned $125M through buybacks.
watch: Net income includes a $3.0M tax benefit.
sources: nCino, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2026 (SEC EDGAR)
